title: Vesper 1.10 — Secure owner setup
changes: Removed the built-in starter password from the server and documentation; a fresh server now refuses to start until a private owner password is configured.
Owner setup requires a unique password of at least 12 characters and keeps owner permissions attached to the account ID.
The Linux hosting installer prompts privately for the owner username and password when they are not configured, then stores them in the server-only .env file.
Bumped the service-worker cache so web clients receive the security update without deleting saved user data.

title: Vesper 1.9 — Owner account and desktop releases
changes: First-run owner account: username Isaac, with the requested starter password. Existing accounts, playlists, history and settings are not overwritten.
Owner account can change its username and password in Settings; owner permissions stay attached to the account even after a username change.
Owner tools show server version, account count, backups and server update controls. Windows installer and GitHub Release auto-update workflow are documented.
Bumped the service-worker cache to refresh updated app files while preserving saved user data.

title: Vesper 1.8 — Global live radio
changes: Added a dedicated Radio section with popular live stations and a searchable global directory.
Browse by country, language, and genre; explore stations ordered by listening activity or community votes.
Live radio plays through Vesper’s audio engine and player bar. Directory data is cached by the provider; stream availability depends on each station.

title: Vesper 1.7 — Tempo detection
changes: Vesper can estimate BPM from music as it plays when audio processing is available, including full-length streams that previously stayed unknown.
Detected tempos are saved locally for faster recognition next time; no audio is uploaded and no extra YouTube lookups are made.
Now Playing shows the BPM and identifies Vesper's estimate. Tempo stays unknown when the rhythm signal is too weak or audio analysis is unavailable.

title: Vesper 1.6 — Faster starts
changes: Vesper quietly prepares the top songs from artists you choose during onboarding, so your first plays can start faster.
Home mix openers and the top five catalog search results are prepared in the background.
Unmatched songs in Liked Songs and playlists are queued for slow background matching; songs already in the on-disk match cache are skipped.
Song rows show Queued, Preparing, Ready, or No full match while background preparation runs.
Background matching is serialized with a 2.2-second gap and pauses when YouTube asks for sign-in. Existing official-version checks and preview settings are preserved.

title: Vesper 1.5
changes: Fixed songs failing to play: YouTube was blocking Vesper as a bot. Vesper now makes far fewer YouTube requests, and can use your browser's YouTube sign-in (Settings › YouTube sign-in).
Clear messages when YouTube is blocking, instead of “format not supported”, and it no longer skips through your whole queue.
No more 30-second previews: songs without a full version are skipped (you can choose the clip instead in Settings).
The lyrics bar is now frosted glass in the song's colours.
Fixed the lyrics box showing under the artwork when lyrics were off, and a better lyrics layout on Mac and PC.

title: Vesper 1.4
changes: Finds the real full song far more often: searches wider, skips look-alikes before checking, and checks up to 10 versions.
Official music videos from the artist's own channel now count, and so do exact uploads of the official audio.
Playlists show Recommended songs based on what's in them, with an Add button.
When a playlist ends, Autoplay keeps going with songs that match that playlist.

title: Vesper 1.3
changes: Full songs now only play when Vesper can confirm the official release: the real artist's own track, at the right length. Fake, AI, sped-up and look-alike uploads are rejected.
If no official full version exists, you hear the official 30-second clip instead of a fake.
Songs saved by older versions are checked again automatically the next time they play.
Lyrics now come from several sources (LRCLIB, NetEase, Lyrics.ovh), so one being down doesn't matter. Found lyrics are saved and load instantly next time.

title: Vesper 1.2
changes: Add to playlist button next to the heart in Now Playing on phones.
The lyrics header now stays at the top while lyrics scroll. Fullscreen lyrics removed.
Fake uploads are hidden: official artist channels come first, and look-alike channels and tiny re-uploads are left out.
Replay plays your top songs behind each story card, and ends with a Your Top Songs mix you can play or save.
What's new appears once after each update, on every device.
Data is backed up every day and before every update, and you stay signed in.
Vesper can now run on a free cloud server, so your Mac doesn't need to be on.
The owner can install updates from Settings.

title: Vesper 1.1
changes: Find a song by typing a line of its lyrics (Search › Lyrics).
Share up to 4 lyric lines as an image in the cover's colours.
Import playlists from Spotify (Exportify CSV) or Apple Music.
Show what you're listening to on Discord (Settings › Playback).
Data saver for full songs, about 22 MB an hour.
Songs now show their real length and switch faster.
Calmer and More upbeat now steer Autoplay properly.
Cleaner iPhone layout.

title: Welcome to Vesper
changes: Vesper desktop app shell for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Your local library and saved data are stored separately from the app install.
Update checks and release notes are built in; updates become available after Vesper releases are published.
